title: Fresh Food Sensor Error
fullDescription: E1 indicates fresh food compartment sensor has failed. Replace thermistor.

title: Defrost Sensor Error
fullDescription: E3 indicates defrost sensor fault. Can cause ice buildup.

title: Defrost System Error
fullDescription: E4 indicates the defrost system failed to complete a cycle. Heater or thermostat may be bad.

title: Condenser Fan Error
fullDescription: E5 indicates condenser fan failure. Clean or replace fan.

title: Forced Defrost Mode
fullDescription: Fd means the fridge has entered forced defrost mode, usually via diagnostic entry. Wait for cycle to complete.

faq.a: Will exit but try wait first.

title: Over Current Error
fullDescription: OC indicates over-current protection triggered. Usually compressor or inverter issue.

title: Open Sensor
fullDescription: OP indicates an open thermistor circuit. Replace the sensor identified.

title: Closed Sensor
fullDescription: CL indicates a shorted thermistor. Replace sensor.

title: High Temperature Alert
fullDescription: HI warns temperature is too high. Check doors, airflow, cooling system.
